title: The 4 Best Automatic Pet Feeders Under $150
h1: The 4 Best Automatic Pet Feeders Under $150
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for automatic pet feeders under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at automatic pet feeders under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: PetSafe Smart Feed Automatic Dog & Cat Feeder
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-cup / 6L hopper capacity, Wi-Fi app control, up to 12 scheduled meals per day, Portions from 1/8 cup to 4 cups.
strengths: Largest hopper capacity of any feeder in this price bracket
1/8-cup portion increments are finer than most Wi-Fi feeders at this price
Backup batteries keep the schedule running through a power outage, a feature some pricier feeders skip
limitations: No camera, so there's no visual confirmation a pet actually ate
Larger footprint on the counter than compact non-Wi-Fi feeders
App and remote alerts depend on a stable home Wi-Fi connection
features: Wi-Fi app control, up to 12 scheduled meals per day
Slow Feed setting and backup battery power

products.name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
products.blurb: Key specs: Microchip and RFID collar tag recognition, Sealed lid between registered visits, Training mode for gradual introduction.
strengths: The only feeder in this list that physically blocks a housemate pet from the wrong bowl
Sealed lid keeps food fresher between visits than an open timed bowl
Long 3-year warranty reflects a design built for years of daily use
limitations: Full app connectivity requires a separately sold hub, an added cost
Single-bowl format, not a multi-day hopper like the PetSafe Smart Feed
Fewer total ratings than PetSafe, though satisfaction among owners is consistent
features: Microchip and RFID collar tag recognition

products.name: PETLIBRO Granary 5L Wi-Fi Automatic Pet Feeder
strengths: App scheduling for up to 10 meals a day
5-liter hopper lasts several days for one cat or small dog
Battery backup keeps scheduled meals running during power cuts
limitations: Needs a 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi setup for remote features
Portion size varies with kibble shape

products.name: WOPET 7L Automatic Feeder with Camera
strengths: Built-in HD camera to watch mealtimes
App scheduling up to 6 meals a day
limitations: Camera features depend on the app

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
